intended_object: The short-root subspace of the F₄ Chevalley Lie algebra over 𝔽₂, i.e. the full integral Chevalley lattice reduced mod 2. It is the 𝔽₂-span of the root vectors e_α for the 24 short roots α, together with the coroots h_{α₃}, h_{α₄} of the two short simple roots. In characteristic 2 this is the Lie ideal used for the special isogeny of F₄ (Steinberg, Carter §12.3). This reading comes from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The body takes the span over ZMod 2 of the images of the basis `f4ModularChevalleyBasis` on the index set `f4ShortChevalleyIndices`. This basis is the base change to ZMod 2 of the integral Chevalley basis of `ZMod 2 ⊗[ℤ] f4ChevalleyLieLattice`. The index set picks the root labels whose squared length `f4Length` is 1, which are the short roots. It also picks the simple-coroot labels at pinned positions 2 and 3. In the `f4Length` table the first four entries are [2,2,1,1], so in Bourbaki labelling α₃ and α₄ are the short simple roots, which matches. This is the standard characteristic-2 short-root ideal: the remaining short coroots reduce mod 2 into the span of h₃ and h₄, and the library proves this in `f4ModularCoroot_mem_shortRootSubspace`. The object is specific to F₄ in characteristic 2, so it is not too narrow. Mathlib has no counterpart.
